menorca.over_budget_rule: allow only if exceptional value / unusually strong deal
ranking_notes: Highest priority: 3+ bedroom farmhouse/country/rustic properties in or near Alaior or Es Mercadal at or below target budget.
Also high priority: 3+ bedroom apartments in the town centers of Alaior or Es Mercadal at or below target budget.
Elsewhere on Menorca: include only when pricing or property quality makes the listing unusually compelling.
Prefer new listings, meaningful price reductions, larger homes, usable outdoor space, and properties needing only manageable renovation.
